attribution_obligations: Credit the creator/licensor and any designated attribution parties.
Retain supplied copyright, license, warranty/disclaimer, and source-URI notices where reasonably practicable.
Include a link or reference to the CC BY 4.0 license.
Indicate modifications and retain supplied indications of previous modifications.
For Physics, attribute Texas Education Agency (TEA), identify the Texas Gateway original, and disclose that OpenStax made changes.
For redistributed print or digital pages, preserve the OpenStax access-for-free attribution required by the title page.
license.third_party_exclusion: All images, media, iframe content, and separately permissioned art are excluded from the bounded language-corpus candidate.

policy_if_retested: Parse pinned CNXML as UTF-8 XML without network expansion.
Select only textual descendants of content after deterministic element-order traversal.
Drop figure, media, image, iframe, and other external-asset nodes completely.
Preserve paragraph/list/heading order; emit MathML text tokens in document order without rendering.
Normalize CRLF/CR to LF, Unicode NFC, trim trailing horizontal whitespace, collapse runs of more than two blank lines to two, and end with exactly one LF.
No semantic rewriting, paraphrasing, OCR, translation, or generated text.
